title: Applicant tracking systems
description: Companies' own hiring systems, where postings live
status: stable
groma:
  id: applicant-tracking-systems
  technology: HTTPS, public JSON posting APIs
---

Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday, Workable, Kula and similar systems hold the postings the boards link to. Their open APIs supply job descriptions for boards that keep none, and list whole boards for funds that run their portfolio board on one of them.
